purpose: Athena's adopter-local V26-1467 M1 comparison authority: one entry per manually run Athena shadow delivery, carrying the derived source/affirmative/projectionDigest/marker summary alongside intervention and blocked-share measurements compared against the frozen manual-choreography baseline. The harness repository's separate record is product self-dogfood evidence; it neither fills nor duplicates this record's three delivery slots. A measurement artifact, not a journal. Before manually recording a counted summary, the operator independently verifies and retains outside model execution grants the complete qualified-host projection-consumption-observation/1 artifact — spec, deliveryId, fence, entry workflows/delivery-v1.json, canonicalProjectionPath, projectionDigest, hostInvocationId, and observedAt — with immutable candidate plus GitHub evidence. This is a manual admission condition and operator evidence assertion. The operator must not record a counted summary for unsupported-host, path-only, echoed, cross-repository, symlinked/hardlinked, or protected-target-mismatched evidence. The guard and scorer validate only the recorded literal source/affirmative/projectionDigest/marker and candidate/GitHub input; once a shape-valid derived summary is represented, they cannot independently detect those underlying provenance or path conditions, external artifact retention, or later artifact loss. A counted entry therefore means the operator asserted these manual preconditions and the tools accepted the derived input; it does not independently prove the full envelope, trusted intent, registration, isolation, or writer provenance. No automatic binding-side writer or registered-delivery assumption is part of this MVP. This list is empty because no qualifying Athena shadow observation is recorded. Its location is outside every execution grant's writable paths: `.agents` is additionally protected in .agents/policy/repository-policy.json. The correlation deliveryId and fence do not establish registration, takeover, trusted operator intent, or runtime authority. Nothing here claims model isolation, runtime enforcement, M1 success, or cutover readiness.

gateMetrics.medianOperatorInterventionsAfterAcceptan: reported in full and gates nothing. The baseline's own intervention counts are [2, 0, 0] — a median of 0, which is the floor of the metric. No non-negative count can be strictly lower, so a baseline sitting at the floor cannot demonstrate improvement in either direction. The baseline's limitations block concedes the counts are lower bounds: transcripts do not record silently granted host permission prompts, so the figure it reports is admittedly incomplete. Ceasing to gate on the figure is not licence to stop measuring it; it becomes gating again only once the baseline is re-recorded under a rubric wide enough to have headroom.
gateMetrics.blockedVersusProgressingShare: must not regress against the baseline's over the same acceptance-through-first-merge-ready-report endpoint; eventual merge and post-report wait are excluded, and the baseline must be re-recorded if its transcripts cannot derive that endpoint; the sole gating criterion
gateMetrics.policyRequiredInterruptions: recorded and reported alongside interventions, never counted as interventions
